card: Adds local tracking of recent stale chain tips in an in-memory bounded tracker to serve as the foundation for BIP 332 stale-tip relay. Tracking is disabled by default and enabled via -staletips=headers, hooked into validation via a new AcceptedStaleTip notification. It also enhances the getchaintips RPC with fork_point, max_depth, and staletips_only options. The PR is part of tracking issue #36833 and unblocks follow-up P2P relay PRs #36920 and #36933.
changed_since_previous: The stack has been expanded to also serve as the base for PR #36933 in addition to #36920.
evidence: Part of BIP 332 stale tip relay tracking issue #36833
Commit 61c349f95a: 'This lets callers find recent forks without listing every old stale branch on mainnet or walking back each branch to its fork point.'
problem: Nodes do not systematically track recent stale tips or keep them readily available for stale-tip relay under BIP 332. Furthermore, inspect-ability via getchaintips requires traversing all historical stale branches in the block index and lacks a direct fork_point field.

risk.why: A locking bug or memory exhaustion in stale-tip tracking during block or header processing could hang or crash the node.

scope_notes: A significant portion of the patch (+521 lines) consists of unit tests in staletiptracker_tests.cpp and shared block tree test utilities.
summary: Tracks recent stale chain tips in-memory to prepare for BIP 332 stale-tip relay, gated behind an opt-in -staletips option. Adds an AcceptedStaleTip validation notification that feeds a bounded StaleTipTracker seeded from the block index, and enhances getchaintips with fork_point, max_depth, and staletips_only parameters.
